faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Answers to your most common questions
faq.q1: What types of furniture do you make?
faq.a1: We offer living room, bedroom, office, dining room and kitchen furniture, along with CNC products and doors.
faq.q2: How long does an order take?
faq.a2: This varies based on product type and quantity. Contact us for detailed information.
faq.q3: Do you deliver to my location?
faq.a3: Yes, we have delivery service to Addis Ababa and surrounding areas.
faq.a4: Yes! We create custom designs based on each client's requirements.
faq.q5: Do your products come with a warranty?
faq.a5: Yes, all our products come with a warranty. Contact us for more details.
